data.long_meaning: Yaghnam means 'calmness in the wilderness' in Arabic, which evokes feelings of tranquility and peace amidst the natural world. This name is perfect for a baby boy whose parents value the beauty and power of nature and wish for their child to grow up with a strong connection to the earth.
